qrLabels.title: QR codes for printed invitations
qrLabels.description: Labels with the household's name and the code that opens only its own invitation (PDF, A4).

qrInvitations.title: Invitations with QR code
qrInvitations.description: The checked invitation, one sheet per household with its own code (print PDF).

tableCards.title: Table cards
tableCards.description: Each table's number or name, with a QR code to the event page when it is published (print PDF).

roomPlan.title: Room plan, to scale
roomPlan.description: The plan with its tables, drawn as vectors at a standard scale, with a scale bar and title block (PDF, A4).

errors.noTables: The seating plan has no tables yet. Add the tables under “Seating”, then download the cards again.
errors.noSpace: The occasion has no room plan yet. Use the venue's plan or draw one under “Room plan”, then download again.
errors.noStationery: There is no invitation yet. Make one under “Invitations”, mark the proof as checked, then download again.
errors.qrOff: The invitation does not have the QR code switched on. Tick “Print each household's QR code on the invitation” under “Invitations”, save and check the proof.

labels.subject: QR code labels for printed invitations
labels.caption: Your invitation
labels.emptyBody: Add the households under “Guests and replies”; each gets a code.

plan.subject: Room plan at 1:{scale}
plan.printNote: Print on A4 at 100 %, without “fit to page”, so that the scale stays true.
plan.unpublished: The seating is not yet published to guests.
